reuse.why: The change reuses budget writes, sheet access, averaging and undo wrappers, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses the category-selection helper introduced for the same policy.

duplication.why: Average actions are consolidated, but copyPreviousMonth duplicates eligibility rules and setZero retains batching and income filtering already provided by forEachMonthActionCategory.

placement.why: Budget policy and calculations remain in actions.ts, with typed method registration and undo integration in app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their shared implementation, registration and tests.

maintainability.why: The shared helpers improve ownership, but maintaining parallel eligibility implementations requires coordinated changes whenever month-wide exclusions evolve.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth implements exclusions outside getMonthActionCategories, and setZero implements iteration and income filtering outside forEachMonthActionCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts: getMonthActionCategories expresses hidden and template exclusions in SQL plus a group filter, while copyPreviousMonth reshapes those same decisions into per-budget JavaScript guards.

abstraction_drift.where: actions.ts: includeHiddenCategories adds one policy parameter and conditional hidden-filter branch; copyPreviousMonth bypasses shared selection, while setZero bypasses shared iteration and income filtering.
